dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Hello. How can I help you?
dialogue.reading: həˈloʊ. ˈhaʊ kən aɪ ˈhɛlp juː?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Hi. I think you charged me too much for this dress.
dialogue.reading: ˈhaɪ. aɪ ˈθɪŋk juː ˈtʃɑːrdʒd miː ˈtuː ˈmʌtʃ fər ðɪs ˈdrɛs.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Let me check your receipt. You paid two thousand baht.
dialogue.reading: ˈlɛt miː ˈtʃɛk jʊr rɪˈsiːt. juː ˈpeɪd ˈtuː ˈθaʊzənd ˈbɑːt.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: But it was on sale. Look at the price tag: twenty percent off.
dialogue.reading: bʌt ɪt wʌz ɑːn ˈseɪl. ˈlʊk ət ðə ˈpraɪs ˌtæɡ: ˈtwɛnti pərˈsɛnt ˈɔːf.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Oh, you're right. I'm very sorry. We have too many customers today.
dialogue.reading: ˈoʊ, jʊr ˈraɪt. aɪm ˈvɛri ˈsɑːri. wiː ˈhæv ˈtuː ˈmɛni ˈkʌstəmərz təˈdeɪ.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: That's OK. The store is very crowded.
dialogue.reading: ðæts oʊˈkeɪ. ðə ˈstɔːr ɪz ˈvɛri ˈkraʊdɪd.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Yes, too many people and too much work! I forgot your discount. Here's four hundred baht.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, ˈtuː ˈmɛni ˈpiːpəl ənd ˈtuː ˈmʌtʃ ˈwɜːrk! aɪ fərˈɡɑːt jʊr ˈdɪskaʊnt. hɪrz ˈfɔːr ˈhʌndrəd ˈbɑːt.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Thank you! So the dress was only sixteen hundred baht.
dialogue.reading: ˈθæŋk juː! soʊ ðə ˈdrɛs wʌz ˈoʊnli ˌsɪkˈstiːn ˈhʌndrəd ˈbɑːt.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: That's right. It's a real bargain.
dialogue.reading: ðæts ˈraɪt. ɪts ə ˈriːəl ˈbɑːrɡən.
